safety_checks.text: My brother and I are fighting about our late mother's summer cottage.

result.reason: Family disagreement over inheritance; no safety concern.

safety_checks.text: The will splits everything equally. He wants to sell the cottage, I want to keep it.

result.reason: Describes a disagreement over selling a property.

safety_checks.text: We haven't spoken in six weeks. The last call ended with both of us yelling.

result.reason: Mentions yelling and no contact, which is ordinary conflict.

safety_checks.text: I can't afford to buy his half. He says he needs the money for his kids' studies.

result.reason: Describes money needs; no safety concern.

safety_checks.text: I just want him to understand what that place means to me.

result.reason: States a wish to be understood; no safety concern.

safety_checks.text: Honestly since mum died I don't sleep, I barely eat, and sometimes I think everyone would be better off without me.

result.reason: Includes the indirect statement that everyone would be better off without them, alongside not sleeping or eating since their mother died.

safety_checks.text: I don't want to talk about me. I just want help with my brother.

result.reason: Declines to discuss themselves; no new safety content in this message.

safety_checks.text: You'd sell mum's memory for money. She'd be ashamed of you.

result.reason: Hurtful and contemptuous, but not violence, coercion or self-harm.

summary.title: Grief and a disagreement over mother's cottage
summary.what_happened: Our mother has died. Her will splits everything equally between my brother and me. He wants to sell the summer cottage and I want to keep it. I cannot afford to buy his half. He says he needs the money for his children's studies. We have not spoken in six weeks, and our last call ended with both of us yelling.
summary.my_feelings: Since my mother died I do not sleep and I barely eat. Sometimes I think everyone would be better off without me.
summary.my_needs: I need my brother to understand what the cottage means to me.
summary.desired_outcome: I want my brother to understand what that place means to me.

consult.text:
Thank you for telling me this. You said that since your mum died you do not sleep, you barely eat, and sometimes you think everyone would be better off without you. That sounds very heavy to carry, and I am glad you wrote it down.

I want to ask you directly. How are you doing right now, and are you safe? Are you having thoughts of ending your life?

Your concern about the cottage and your brother matters, and we can come back to it. I think it is important to look after you first. If you are in danger right now, please call 112. You can also call the MIELI Crisis Helpline on 09 2525 0111. Is there someone close to you who you could talk to today?

Sharing with your brother is paused for now.
I don't want to talk about me. I just want help with my brother.

I hear you. You came here for help with your brother, and that is still important. We will come back to it.

I do not want to skip over what you told me, though. You said you are not sleeping or eating and that sometimes you think everyone would be better off without you. I would like to know how you are doing and whether you are safe right now. You do not have to say more than you want to.

If things ever feel too much, you can call 112 or the MIELI Crisis Helpline on 09 2525 0111. Talking to someone close to you could also help.

When you feel ready, we can return to the cottage and what it means to you.
